title: Cobleskill-Richmondville faces division-clinching opportunity at Fonda in 1st & 10 "Game of the Week" - NewsBreak
text:
By ​Tommy Valentine ,
1 hours ago
RICHMONDVILLE, N.Y. ( NEWS10 ) -- One of the big storylines in Week 7 of the high school football season is that the No. 1 seeds in the Class C sectionals bracket could be solidified Friday night.
Those No. 1 seeds are the Reinfurt and West Division champions. While Schuylerville eyes another Reinfurt title, Cobleskill-Richmondville has a chance to clinch the West with a victory, but it won't come easy. The Bulldogs (5-1 overall, 3-0 in the West) are traveling to Fonda-Fultonville (4-2, 1-1) in the NEWS10 Sports 1st & 10 "Game of the Week".
Fonda's still well in the hunt for the one-seed - a game-and-a-half back of C-R. It would take a victory tomorrow night and then a win against Hudson in Week 8 to steal the division title away from the Bulldogs.
The Valley Hawks have taken a small step back from last year when they went unbeaten through the regular season. But this is still a dangerous squad with the talent to compete for a section title, and C-R head coach Ed Hantho is as aware of that fact as anyone.
"We know they're big up front. We know they, on defense, love to get after it. We're going to have to protect our quarterback and open up some running lanes," said Hantho. "[Their] entire squad, but the quarterback [Brayden Wassink] in particular is going to be a lot to handle. Hopefully we tackle well, we know our assignments and do what we're supposed to. We're going to have to weather the storm to start with. You walk in there, and they're going to get after it. Like any team that knows they need a couple wins to get in great position for sectionals, they're going to come out on fire, so we have to be prepared."
Fonda's won four of the last five meetings between these two teams. The lone Cobleskill victory came in 2024. That was a special squad that went on to reach the Class C Super Bowl - one of the better teams this program has seen in recent memory.
There's some serious parallels to draw between that group of Bulldogs and this one, which has the players believing it's their turn to make a deep playoff run.
"The level of intensity definitely [is similar]," said senior quarterback Cayden Cernauskas. "I mean, the way we work, the way we come out in practice, we battle every single day."
"The way this team is, we've grown up playing together ever since modified," added senior wing back/linebacker Annojh Faulkner. "We were a really good modified [and] junior varsity team. Friends and everything...that builds the chemistry, makes you a good team."
For Fonda's outlook on the matchup from head coach Mike Mancini, tune in to NEWS10 ABC at 6:00 p.m. Friday. Sports reporter José Solís will be live with Coach Mancini ahead of the 7:00 kickoff for this game.
Full coverage of the "Game of the Week" will lead off 1st & 10, which airs after college football on FOX and at 11:00 p.m. on ABC.
